com.esignal.jstandard.event

Class DictionaryEvent

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.util.EventObject
      • com.esignal.jstandard.event.StatusEvent
        • com.esignal.jstandard.event.DictionaryEvent
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    TurnAroundAware, java.io.Serializable

    public class DictionaryEvent
extends StatusEvent
    This class holds dictionary related information such as version, flags bitmap, a boolean to signify if this is a full dictionary or a update, and the dictionary string containing Flex data fields and related information for that dictionary version.

    Use isFullDictionary() to determine if this event contains a full dictionary or an update. An update is used to bring the client's cached dictionary up to the current version specified in the DictionaryEvent, or the client will receive a full dictionary. It's the client's responsibility to merge dictionary updates with their cached dictionary. When a full dictionary is received, the client should replace their cached dictionary with the full dictionary. It is recommended to request a dictionary daily in order to stay current with the latest dictionary.

    Since:
